selection_dossier.core_question: Anthropic 被美国政府强制下线 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型，这对普通技术人意味着什么？
selection_dossier.why_this_topic_matters: 这是首次美国政府直接依据出口管制法规强制AI公司下线已公开发布的最强模型，且波及所有客户（包括美国国内的外国国籍员工）。事件揭示了AI模型可用性风险从理论变为现实，技术人需要重新评估单一供应商依赖、业务连续性策略和合规成本。
fact_summary: 2026年6月12日，美国政府依据国家安全出口管制指令，要求Anthropic暂停所有外国国民（包括Anthropic的外国国籍员工）对Fable 5和Mythos 5的访问。
Anthropic于当日17:21收到指令，为合规立即完全禁用这两个模型，所有客户均无法访问。
Anthropic官方声明称，政府认为存在一种绕过Fable 5安全机制的越狱方法，但Anthropic评估后认为该方法只能发现少量已知的次要漏洞，且其他公开模型也能发现这些漏洞。
其他Anthropic模型（如Opus 4.8）不受影响。
多家权威媒体（The Verge, WIRED, BBC, Reuters, The Guardian, Al Jazeera）均报道了此事件。
Fable 5于2026年6月9日发布，是Anthropic当时最强大的模型。

The net effect of this order is that we must abruptly disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all our customers to ensure compliance. Access to all other Anthropic models will not be affected. We received the directive from the government today at 5:21pm (ET). The letter did not provide specific details of its national security concern. Our understanding is that the government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or “jailbreaking” Fable 5. We reviewed a demonstration of this specific technique being used to identify a small number of previously known, minor vulnerabilities. These vulnerabilities all appear relatively simple, and we have found that other publicly-available models are able to discover them as well without requiring a bypass. material_pack.core_question: Anthropic 被美国政府强制下线 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型，这对普通技术人意味着什么？
material_pack.why_this_topic_matters: 这是首次美国政府直接依据出口管制法规强制AI公司下线已公开发布的最强模型，且波及所有客户（包括美国国内的外国国籍员工）。事件揭示了AI模型可用性风险从理论变为现实，技术人需要重新评估单一供应商依赖、业务连续性策略和合规成本。
fact_summary: 2026年6月12日，美国政府依据国家安全出口管制指令，要求Anthropic暂停所有外国国民（包括Anthropic的外国国籍员工）对Fable 5和Mythos 5的访问。
Anthropic于当日17:21收到指令，为合规立即完全禁用这两个模型，所有客户均无法访问。
Anthropic官方声明称，政府认为存在一种绕过Fable 5安全机制的越狱方法，但Anthropic评估后认为该方法只能发现少量已知的次要漏洞，且其他公开模型也能发现这些漏洞。
其他Anthropic模型（如Opus 4.8）不受影响。
多家权威媒体（The Verge, WIRED, BBC, Reuters, The Guardian, Al Jazeera）均报道了此事件。
Fable 5于2026年6月9日发布，是Anthropic当时最强大的模型。

We received the directive from the government today at 5:21pm (ET). The letter did not provide specific details of its national security concern. Our understanding is that the government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or “jailbreaking” Fable 5. We reviewed a demonstration of this specific technique being used to identify a small number of previously known, minor vulnerabilities. These vulnerabilities all appear relatively simple, and we have found that other publicly-available models are able to discover them as well without requiring a bypass. Read more Today we’re launching Claude Fable 5 : a Mythos-class 1 model that we’ve made safe for general use. Fable 5’s capabilities exceed those of any model we’ve ever made generally available. The longer and more complex the task, the larger Fable 5’s lead over our other models. Releasing a model this capable comes with risks. Without safeguards, Fable 5’s capabilities in areas like cybersecurity could be misused to cause serious damage. We’ve therefore launched the model with safeguards that mean queries on some topics will instead receive a response from our next-most-capable model, Claude Opus 4.8. To release the model both safely and quickly, we’ve tuned these safeguards conservatively—they’ll sometimes catch harmless requests, though they trigger, on average, in less than 5% of sessions. With more capable models arriving in the coming months, we’re working to improve our safeguards and reduce false positives as quickly as we can. selection_dossier.core_question: Anthropic 被美国政府强制下线 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型，这对普通技术人意味着什么？
selection_dossier.why_this_topic_matters: 这是首次美国政府直接依据出口管制法规强制AI公司下线已公开发布的最强模型，且波及所有客户（包括美国国内的外国国籍员工）。事件揭示了AI模型可用性风险从理论变为现实，技术人需要重新评估单一供应商依赖、业务连续性策略和合规成本。
fact_summary: 2026年6月12日，美国政府依据国家安全出口管制指令，要求Anthropic暂停所有外国国民（包括Anthropic的外国国籍员工）对Fable 5和Mythos 5的访问。
Anthropic于当日17:21收到指令，为合规立即完全禁用这两个模型，所有客户均无法访问。
Anthropic官方声明称，政府认为存在一种绕过Fable 5安全机制的越狱方法，但Anthropic评估后认为该方法只能发现少量已知的次要漏洞，且其他公开模型也能发现这些漏洞。
其他Anthropic模型（如Opus 4.8）不受影响。
多家权威媒体（The Verge, WIRED, BBC, Reuters, The Guardian, Al Jazeera）均报道了此事件。
Fable 5于2026年6月9日发布，是Anthropic当时最强大的模型。

material_pack.core_question: Anthropic 被美国政府强制下线 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型，这对普通技术人意味着什么？
material_pack.why_this_topic_matters: 这是首次美国政府直接依据出口管制法规强制AI公司下线已公开发布的最强模型，且波及所有客户（包括美国国内的外国国籍员工）。事件揭示了AI模型可用性风险从理论变为现实，技术人需要重新评估单一供应商依赖、业务连续性策略和合规成本。
fact_summary: 2026年6月12日，美国政府依据国家安全出口管制指令，要求Anthropic暂停所有外国国民（包括Anthropic的外国国籍员工）对Fable 5和Mythos 5的访问。
Anthropic于当日17:21收到指令，为合规立即完全禁用这两个模型，所有客户均无法访问。
Anthropic官方声明称，政府认为存在一种绕过Fable 5安全机制的越狱方法，但Anthropic评估后认为该方法只能发现少量已知的次要漏洞，且其他公开模型也能发现这些漏洞。
其他Anthropic模型（如Opus 4.8）不受影响。
多家权威媒体（The Verge, WIRED, BBC, Reuters, The Guardian, Al Jazeera）均报道了此事件。
Fable 5于2026年6月9日发布，是Anthropic当时最强大的模型。

The net effect of this order is that we must abruptly disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all our customers to ensure compliance. Access to all other Anthropic models will not be affected. We received the directive from the government today at 5:21pm (ET). The letter did not provide specific details of its national security concern. Our understanding is that the government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or “jailbreaking” Fable 5. We reviewed a demonstration of this specific technique being used to identify a small number of previously known, minor vulnerabilities. These vulnerabilities all appear relatively simple, and we have found that other publicly-available models are able to discover them as well without requiring a bypass. Anthropic’s posture with respect to Fable’s safeguards, as laid out in our launch blog post , is the following: We have instituted strong safeguards that greatly reduce the likelihood that Fable is misused for tasks related to cybersecurity (among others). In fact, our safeguards are so strong that many users have complained that they are overly broad. Read more Today we’re launching Claude Fable 5 : a Mythos-class 1 model that we’ve made safe for general use. Fable 5’s capabilities exceed those of any model we’ve ever made generally available. It is state-of-the-art on nearly all tested benchmarks of AI capability, showing exceptional performance in software engineering, knowledge work, vision, scientific research, and many other areas. The longer and more complex the task, the larger Fable 5’s lead over our other models. Releasing a model this capable comes with risks. Without safeguards, Fable 5’s capabilities in areas like cybersecurity could be misused to cause serious damage. We’ve therefore launched the model with safeguards that mean queries on some topics will instead receive a response from our next-most-capable model, Claude Opus 4.8. To release the model both safely and quickly, we’ve tuned these safeguards conservatively—they’ll sometimes catch harmless requests, though they trigger, on average, in less than 5% of sessions. With more capable models arriving in the coming months, we’re working to improve our safeguards and reduce false positives as quickly as we can.
